test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

The news **are too good to be true**.

options.text: is very good to be true
is too good to be true
are so good to be true
is so good to be true

solution:
The correct answer is '**is too good to be true**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**is**" should be used instead of "**are**" because the subject "**news**" is singular, despite being plural in form.
 
• The expression "**too good to be true**" is an established idiomatic phrase that conveys skepticism or disbelief.
 
• **Option 2** is grammatically correct and accurately replaces the highlighted part of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The news is too good to be true."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "is very good to be true"** is incorrect because "very good" does not convey the same meaning as "too good" and changes the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "are so good to be true"** is incorrect because "are" is not grammatically appropriate for the singular subject "news."
 
• **Option 4: "is so good to be true"** is incorrect due to the nonsensical inclusion of "$0."
